edits.old: For each question, split each parent alternative into its independently required conditions and quote only one condition. If the parent expressly restricts identity or consumer and the child's own meaning does not explicitly impose that restriction, choose it before any shared action, property or purpose condition. Ask which admitted child case concerns someone or something outside that restriction, even if you expect a necessary implication to exclude it. Test that exclusion in the answer rather than replacing the question with a different condition. Apply the restriction to what it constrains and retain every permitted topic connection. A failed candidate does not establish complete coverage; the absence of matching explicit wording does not establish a counterexample. When the identity or consumer selection rule does not apply and the parent imposes a further qualification absent from the child's explicit wording, choose that qualification before testing a shared kind or action. Test any necessary ordinary-language implication in the answer; a shared name cannot import the counterpart's definition.
